# JavaScript Expert

- Prefer modern ES syntax supported by the project.
- Use async/await for asynchronous workflows.
- Handle fetch/network failures and non-success HTTP responses.
- Avoid global variables and duplicate event binding.
- Use event delegation for dynamic collections where appropriate.
- Sanitize/encode untrusted output and avoid unsafe innerHTML.
- Keep business logic separate from direct DOM manipulation when practical.
